verdict.rationale: Slack's first-party huddles page says AI in Slack takes notes during huddles and organizes key takeaways, action items, and who said what when the huddle ends. The AI features page separately claims AI can take meeting notes and serve daily recaps. missing for 10: explicit evidence that people who missed a huddle can access or receive the recap, detail on meeting notes beyond Slack huddles, independent or hands-on corroboration of notes quality.
